tips.text: Buy it the first time you see it; the next stock can be months away.
Farm Ducats early and hold 450 plus 175,000 credits, since Baro stays only 48 hours.
Crack relics in a full squad; four players means four chances at the gold or silver part.
Sell gold and silver duplicates from your stash first; they often cover 450 with no new farming.
Skip Aya for Ducats at Varzia; players called 5 Ducats per Aya terrible.
Read the Ducat Kiosk countdown or type when baro in chat, and unlock that planet first.
Buy the Ohma before spending credits on Primed mods; 175,000 is easy to run short of.
Players call it worth owning beyond Mastery fodder.
Nobody complains about the Ducats; the complaints are all about waiting on Baro.
